scope: actual Kaggle image-level ISIC-labelled pilot, not grouped held-out or clinical validation
preprocessing: explicit nearest-neighbour square512 before method-specific embedding

threshold.origin: official README clean checkpoint, not selected on pilot outcomes

interpretation: Comparison against a published baseline now executed on actual attached images, not the GitHub pixel mirror.
Only eight images, one per class; no class-wise or population superiority claim.
Classical missed no changed pixels in tested edits, but highlights whole blocks.
EditGuard replacement mean IoU .8488137 exceeds classical .8024691, with 962 missed pixels.
EditGuard copy mean IoU .7707485 is below classical .8024691, including one total 4096-pixel miss.
EditGuard has 38 intact false-highlight pixels across 6 of 8 inputs; this is not a calibrated paper image-detection assessment.
JPEG case measures altered RGB relative to each protected reference, not benign-tolerance success. High JPEG changed-pixel IoU must not be advertised as robustness.
Data identity and patient/lesion independence remain unverified. Full label count is not sample size.
next_gate: No automatic larger training run; retain classical reference and investigate catastrophic localisation misses before proposing another learned mechanism.
